items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model with Fable carrying strong cyber/biology safeguards for general availability. Outputs are up to 30% faster than 5.1 at lower pricing ($8/$40 per million tokens).
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，兩者底層模型相同，Fable 帶有較強的網路與生物安全防護並全面開放。輸出速度較 5.1 快最多 30%，定價較低（每百萬 token $8/$40）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Anthropic’s clearest push to claim leadership on hard technical and scientific work just as it starts IPO marketing. The dual Fable/Mythos access model continues its verified dual-track approach to high-capability models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 在啟動 IPO 行銷之際，最明確主張在硬技術與科學工作上領先的動作。Fable/Mythos 雙軌存取模式延續其對高能力模型的驗證式雙軌做法。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作最有能力的模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域樹立新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70–78 per share
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，預計股價 70–78 美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO of Class A common stock. The offering covers 825 million shares (most primary), with an expected price range of $70–78 per share and a Nasdaq listing under “ANT.” Underwriters received an option for additional shares.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 A 類普通股擬議 IPO 路演。發行涵蓋 8.25 億股（大多為主發行），預計股價區間 70–78 美元，將在那斯達克以「ANT」掛牌。承銷商獲額外股份選擇權。
items_flat.analysis_en: The formal roadshow confirms Anthropic is moving ahead with a public listing while shipping a major model upgrade. Valuation and demand will be tested against recent AI-sector volatility and the company’s own safety disclosures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 正式路演確認 Anthropic 在推出重大模型升級的同時推進公開上市。估值與需求將面臨近期 AI 產業波動以及公司自身安全揭露的考驗。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天 Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 A 類普通股擬議首次公開發行路演。首次公開發行價格預計介於每股 70.00 至 78.00 美元之間。

items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model. It improves dexterity, reliability and safety across 200+ tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz production proof-of-concept with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid, it achieved 96% success on kitting tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其迄今最有能力的視覺-語言-動作模型。它在 200 多項任務上提升靈巧度、可靠性與安全性。在與 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人於 Mercedes-Benz 產線的概念驗證中，裝配任務成功率達 96%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The factory pilot is the most concrete real-world robotics result DeepMind has shown recently. Sustained high success outside controlled settings and broader partner adoption remain the key open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工廠試點是 DeepMind 近期展示的最具體真實世界機器人成果。在受控環境外維持高成功率以及更廣泛夥伴採用，仍是關鍵未解問題。
items_flat.quote: During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 Mercedes-Benz 產線的真實世界概念驗證中，我們的模型協助 Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 人形機器人以 96% 成功率撿取並包裝汽車零件。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon now available to developers and consumers
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 現已向開發者與消費者開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available via API in AI Studio and Gemini for business at the same introductory price as Argon ($2/$10 per million tokens). It is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app and Search AI Mode. On the new MKA benchmark it ranked #2 at 6x lower average cost than the top model.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 透過 AI Studio 與 Gemini for business 的 API 開放 Gemini 4 Carbon，定價與 Argon 相同（每百萬 token $2/$10）。它正向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini 應用與 Search AI Mode 推出。在新的 MKA 基準測試中，它排名第二，平均成本較最高分模型低 6 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broad availability of Carbon expands Google’s frontier-model options beyond the earlier limited Fairwind cyber release. Pricing parity with Argon lowers the barrier, but sustained performance across long-horizon and cyber tasks outside Google’s own evals remains to be independently confirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon 的廣泛供應擴大了 Google 在先前有限 Fairwind 網路釋出之外的前沿模型選項。與 Argon 相同定價降低門檻，但在 Google 自身評估之外，長時程與網路任務的持續表現仍待獨立確認。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens).
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 透過 Google AI Studio 與 Gemini for business 的 API 向所有付費開發者與企業開放，定價與 Gemini 4 Argon 相同（每百萬輸入 token $2、每百萬輸出 token $10）。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol code
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 形式驗證 Signal 協定程式碼
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that formally verified key security properties of the actual compiled code of Signal’s libsignal implementation (including PQXDH and Triple Ratchet) down to machine-code level. Agents powered by Gemini Carbon generated over six million lines of Lean proofs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，一個代理框架，形式驗證了 Signal libsignal 實作（包括 PQXDH 與 Triple Ratchet）實際編譯程式碼的關鍵安全屬性，直至機器碼層級。由 Gemini Carbon 驅動的代理產生超過六百萬行 Lean 證明。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-level and implementation-level proofs for a real cryptographic library is a meaningful milestone. Scalability beyond this single protocol and the residual trusted setup for specifications remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 為真實密碼學函式庫橋接設計層級與實作層級證明是有意義的里程碑。超越單一協定的可擴展性以及規格的殘餘信任設定仍待解決。
items_flat.quote: Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. It's also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的工作標誌著 AI 首次被用於以這種深度形式驗證廣泛部署的密碼學協定。這也是此類廣泛部署協定的實作首次被任何方法（無論有無 AI）形式驗證。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 pre-training done, soft Bot rollout later this week
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，本週稍晚對 Bot 軟性推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that xAI dumped JAX/SGLang and rewrote the RL and inference stack in C/C++. Pre-training for Grok 4.8 is finished, the model is now in RL with rising evals, and a soft rollout to Grok Bot users is planned later this week. He said it will bear no resemblance to 4.7.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 xAI 棄用 JAX/SGLang，並以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊。Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成，模型現正進行 RL 且評估分數上升，計畫本週稍晚對 Grok Bot 用戶進行軟性推出。他表示它將與 4.7 截然不同。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is the clearest public status update on 4.8 to date and sets expectations for a limited Bot-first rollout. Until public benchmarks or broader access appear, claims about capability jumps remain provisional.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 該貼文是迄今最清晰的 4.8 公開狀態更新，並設定有限 Bot 優先推出的預期。在公開基準測試或更廣泛存取出現之前，能力跳躍的宣稱仍屬暫時性。
items_flat.quote: Training (aka pre-training) is done. ... Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb. We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
items_flat.quote_zh: 訓練（即預訓練）已完成。……現在 4.8 正在進行 RL，評估分數開始上升。我們將於本週稍晚對 Bot 用戶進行軟性推出，看看情況如何。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 截然不同（幸好）。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT beta with Business Hub and Agents
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 商業功能測試版，含 Business Hub 與 Agents
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. Through Business Hub, eligible businesses can claim their profile, update details, add product feeds, and view aggregated insights on mentions and clicks. Eligible U.S. ecommerce and online service businesses can also publish a Business Agent that answers customer questions in a clearly labeled separate conversation.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 以測試版推出 ChatGPT 中的商業功能。透過 Business Hub，符合資格的企業可認領其檔案、更新細節、新增產品饋送，並查看提及與點擊的彙總洞察。符合資格的美國電商與線上服務企業也可發布 Business Agent，在明確標示的獨立對話中回答客戶問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves ChatGPT further toward a commercial discovery and transaction surface for its large weekly user base. Privacy safeguards (no sharing of individual conversations) and the U.S.-only Agent launch limit immediate reach, and adoption will depend on verification friction and merchant uptake.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 ChatGPT 進一步朝向其龐大每週用戶群的商業發現與交易介面。隱私防護（不分享個別對話）以及僅限美國的 Agent 推出限制了立即覆蓋範圍，採用將取決於驗證摩擦與商家接受度。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, giving businesses a new way to connect with the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT each week.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們以測試版推出 ChatGPT 中的商業功能，為企業提供與每週使用 ChatGPT 的 12 億人連結的新方式。

items_flat.title_en: Google and Artificial Analysis launch Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark
items_flat.title_zh: Google 與 Artificial Analysis 推出多模態知識代理基準測試
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind partnered with Artificial Analysis to launch the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark. It evaluates agents on 200 real-world visually complex knowledge-work tasks created with domain experts. Gemini 4 Carbon ranked #2 in quality and completed tasks at 6x lower average cost than the top-scoring model.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與 Artificial Analysis 合作推出多模態知識代理（MKA）基準測試。它評估代理在與領域專家共同創建的 200 項真實世界視覺複雜知識工作任務上的表現。Gemini 4 Carbon 在品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。
items_flat.analysis_en: MKA addresses a real gap—most existing benchmarks ignore visual and layout-heavy professional work. Google’s strong cost-performance result on its own new eval is notable but will need broader independent runs to confirm relative ranking.
items_flat.analysis_zh: MKA 填補了真實缺口——大多數現有基準測試忽略視覺與版面複雜的專業工作。Google 在其自身新評估上的強成本表現值得注意，但仍需更廣泛的獨立執行來確認相對排名。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon achieves #2 in quality among the models we tested, and completes tasks at 6x lower cost on average compared to the top scoring model.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在我們測試的模型中品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。

google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與 Artificial Analysis 合作推出多模態知識代理（MKA）基準測試。它評估代理在與領域專家共同創建的 200 項真實世界視覺複雜知識工作任務上的表現。Gemini 4 Carbon 在品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。
google.analysis_en: MKA addresses a real gap—most existing benchmarks ignore visual and layout-heavy professional work. Google’s strong cost-performance result on its own new eval is notable but will need broader independent runs to confirm relative ranking.
google.analysis_zh: MKA 填補了真實缺口——大多數現有基準測試忽略視覺與版面複雜的專業工作。Google 在其自身新評估上的強成本表現值得注意，但仍需更廣泛的獨立執行來確認相對排名。
google.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon achieves #2 in quality among the models we tested, and completes tasks at 6x lower cost on average compared to the top scoring model.
google.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在我們測試的模型中品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。

xai.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 pre-training done, soft Bot rollout later this week
xai.title_zh: Musk：Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，本週稍晚對 Bot 軟性推出
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that xAI dumped JAX/SGLang and rewrote the RL and inference stack in C/C++. Pre-training for Grok 4.8 is finished, the model is now in RL with rising evals, and a soft rollout to Grok Bot users is planned later this week. He said it will bear no resemblance to 4.7.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 xAI 棄用 JAX/SGLang，並以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊。Grok 4.8 預訓練已完成，模型現正進行 RL 且評估分數上升，計畫本週稍晚對 Grok Bot 用戶進行軟性推出。他表示它將與 4.7 截然不同。
xai.analysis_en: The post is the clearest public status update on 4.8 to date and sets expectations for a limited Bot-first rollout. Until public benchmarks or broader access appear, claims about capability jumps remain provisional.
xai.analysis_zh: 該貼文是迄今最清晰的 4.8 公開狀態更新，並設定有限 Bot 優先推出的預期。在公開基準測試或更廣泛存取出現之前，能力跳躍的宣稱仍屬暫時性。
xai.quote: Training (aka pre-training) is done. ... Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb. We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
xai.quote_zh: 訓練（即預訓練）已完成。……現在 4.8 正在進行 RL，評估分數開始上升。我們將於本週稍晚對 Bot 用戶進行軟性推出，看看情況如何。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 截然不同（幸好）。

brief_en: Anthropic advances its IPO roadshow at a $70–78 range while Google expands Gemini 4 Carbon access and ships robotics and verification advances. OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT beta; xAI signals a soft Grok 4.8 Bot rollout this week.
brief_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演（70–78 美元區間），Google 擴大 Gemini 4 Carbon 供應並推進機器人與形式驗證。OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 商業功能測試版；xAI 表示本週對 Bot 用戶軟性推出 Grok 4.8。
